description: This file defines a custom report class for generating an auction total report in XML format within an Odoo (OpenERP) module. It includes methods to gather auction lot data, compute statistics, and produce an XML report using specified templates.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml, responsible for creating an XML report of auction totals.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report summarizing auction lot data, including statistics on sold, unsold, paid, unpaid, and costs.
